Immutable Views: Identity Includes the Reader [Part 2/4]: Subtopics: Commit children first, then seal the parent — Two systems can read identical bytes and produce different evidence because their parsers, profiles, feature sets, or limits differ. AINA therefore binds a view to all of them: RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS) gives the manifest one deterministic serialization.
